subject: Follow-up: KMS / CMK questions from today's call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: KMS / CMK questions from today's call

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups on the encryption & KMS items you raised during the demo:

- At-rest encryption: Redwood encrypts model artifacts and customer data at-rest using AES-256. For hosted customers we manage the encryption keys by default.
- In-transit: All traffic is TLS 1.2+ between clients and our control plane; traffic between control plane and inference nodes is mutually authenticated TLS.
- Customer-managed keys (CMK): We support CMKs via integrations with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted customers we offer a bring-your-own-key option on Dedicated and Private only; hosted can be configured for CSE (customer-supplied encryption) in select contracts.
- HSM: We integrate with cloud HSM-backed KMS (e.g., AWS CloudHSM-backed KMS) for FIPS/HSM-backed key material where customers require it.

Action items I promised to follow up on today:
1) Send the vendor security questionnaire (attached) so you can start the formal review with your security team.
2) Share a simple KMS architecture diagram showing how CMK flows for Dedicated vs Hosted.
3) Confirm current SOC 2 status and timeline for the latest report.

Next steps: I attached the questionnaire (PDF) and a KMS arch diagram. Would you be able to share an initial list of required controls from your side or the contact for your procurement/security team? If it helps, I can loop in Dev (cc'd) for any deep crypto/KMS questions.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-vendor-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

- For compliance reasons we prefer customer-managed keys stored in an HSM-backed KMS. We are evaluating whether we can accept Redwood-hosted inference with a BYOK flow, or whether we need an isolated Dedicated environment.
- We will start the vendor security questionnaire today; procurement@fintechco.com handles contracts and compliance intake.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether CMK support for Hosted customers is available now or only on Dedicated/Private? Also, can you share the SOC 2 Type II report (or date you expect the latest report to be available)?

Appreciate it — I'll get the questionnaire to our security team and loop procurement.

Alex

Subject: Vendor security questionnaire + KMS details (redwood-vendor-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf)

Hi Alex / procurement team —

Attaching the formal vendor security questionnaire (PDF) for FinTechCo's review. A few notes to speed the intake:

- SOC 2: Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II certified (reporting period: 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31). We can share the report under NDA — I have a standard upload link if you'd like to request it.
- CMK availability: Customer-managed keys via cloud-native KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments today. For hosted customers we do offer a limited BYOK flow for select enterprise agreements (please let me know if you want that path — we can escalate).
- HSM: For customers requiring HSM-backed key material, we recommend Dedicated with an HSM-backed KMS configuration (AWS CloudHSM or equivalent).

I've also attached a simple KMS architecture diagram that shows how the CMK is used to encrypt at-rest blobs and how data keys are rotated and cached. Dev is cc'd for any technical deep-dive.

Requests from our side to help the review move faster:
1) Please confirm the procurement contact who will own the questionnaire (I included procurement@fintechco.com but feel free to forward).
2) If you have any compliance-specific items (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR data residency), flag them and we'll scope a Dedicated/Private proposal with the right controls.

I'll also drop the SOC 2 upload link (under NDA) if you confirm a contact.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-vendor-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf, kms-arch-diagram.png
